definition: Larry Paul Heck is the Rhesa Screven Farmer, Jr., Advanced Computing Concepts Chair, Georgia Research Alliance Eminent Scholar, Co-Executive Director of the Machine Learning Center and Professor at the Georgia Institute of Technology.
details: His career spans many of the sub-disciplines of artificial intelligence, including conversational AI, speech recognition and speaker recognition, natural language processing, web search, online advertising and acoustics. He is best known for his role as a co-founder of the Microsoft Cortana Personal Assistant and his early work in deep learning for speech processing.

explainer.lead: Larry Heck is a Ph.D. Georgia Institute of Technology 1991.

contributions.name: In that same year, Heck led one of the first large scale deployments of Transformer-Based LLMs as part of the Bixby Categories launch at the 2019 Samsung Developer Conference.

timeline.what: Heck received the MSEE in 1989 and the PhD in 1991 under advisor Prof. James H. McClellan.

Heck deployed this DNN in 1999 with Nuance Communications at the Home Shopping Network, representing the first major industrial application of deep learning with over 100K Nuance Verifier voiceprints.
In 2008, Heck and Ron Brachman combined search & advertising quality with Yahoo!
Heck was named a Microsoft Distinguished Engineer in 2012 and joined Microsoft Research that same year.
In 2017, Heck joined Samsung as SVP and co-head of global AI Research.
